# Hermês, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Hermês** never stopped working.

Hermês's myths are almost always about crossing boundaries and getting away with it. He is the divine child who outwits his older brother on the day of his birth.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **8 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Hermês
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Messengers, Commerce, Thieves
- **Pattern seats:** 8
- **Sectors touched:** Commerce & Governance · Technology & Innovation · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Finance, Wealth & Commerce
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 104 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Born in a Cave on Mount Cyllene.** Hermês was born to Zeús and the nymph Maia in a remote Arcadian cave.  By midday of his first day he had invented the lyre from a tortoise shell and slipped out to steal Apóllōn's cattle. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**The Lyre for the Herd.** Zeús ordered Hermês to return the cattle.  Hermês played the lyre he had invented, and Apóllōn was so enchanted that he traded his whole herd for the instrument. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Finance, Wealth & Commerce

*Banking, investment, and commercial enterprise. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*God of commerce; the marketplace is his agora.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Retail & Marketplaces

*Shops, marketplaces, and e-commerce — where goods meet buyers. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*God of the marketplace itself — commerce, exchange, and the deal well made.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Hermês performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Communication, Messaging & Logistics

*Telecoms, messaging platforms, and supply chains. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*The messenger god; commerce, travelers, and the routes between.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Hermês performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Automotive & Mobility

*Vehicles, road transport, and the freedom of movement. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*God of roads and wayfarers; the traveller’s patron, the journey made safe.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Hermês performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Mapping & Geospatial

*Maps, GIS, and location intelligence. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*God of roads and travellers; the hermae were the waymarkers of the ancient road network.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Hermês performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

The temple holds 3 further seats beyond these — the full, argued list lives on its [patterns floor](/sites/hermes/patterns/).

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Hermês's myths are almost always about crossing boundaries and getting away with it. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in finance, wealth & commerce, retail & marketplaces, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/hermes/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
